official_conversion_authority.purpose: broker-native shortest conversion path between assets when direct conversion is unavailable
official_conversion_authority.executable_leg_direction: base->quote at BID; quote->base at inverse ASK

corrected_tail_semantics.per_window: median/p75/p90/p95 are quantiles of all causal spread states inside each 10-minute window
corrected_tail_semantics.qualification: median of per-window p75/range and p75 of per-window p95/range, repeated after same-window round-trip commission
corrected_tail_semantics.worst_window: preserved as diagnostic; not sole pre-alpha kill rule

cross_fx_examples: EURJPY/AUDJPY/CADJPY/MXNJPY/ZARJPY/NOKSEK may use broker-native USD->quote conversion chain instead of being mechanically unresolved because USD is absent from the traded pair.
